objective: Independently verify the exact-SHA M416 Synopsys DC evidence, recompute all M416-versus-M412 deltas from raw reports, reconcile the M414/M415 functional and cycle-ledger evidence, and decide whether the balanced selected slice may advance to Formality and PrimeTime without upgrading any prohibited claim.
required_checks: Verify the M416 contract, runner, immutable input identities, evidence manifest and outer seal.
Parse raw DC reports rather than trusting the M416 receipt for area, cell count, sequential cells, setup slack, hold slack, logic levels, macro count and all five constraint classes.
Audit check_design/check_timing evidence and DC logs for error, unresolved reference, black box, inferred latch and timing-loop signatures.
Recompute DEL cell count, DEL area and DEL area fraction from report_reference, while refusing causal hold-guard attribution without an A/B synthesis.
Recompute the same-method M416-versus-M412 deltas and check that the 3 ns SDC, technology libraries, ideal clock, wireload and hold-guard method are identical.
Verify M414 directed, integration and full-runtime VCS seals and zero-mismatch receipt, plus the independent M415 seal.
Require the frozen M401 matcher-cycle ledger to remain exactly 67912100 and docs/359 to remain at its frozen SHA256.
Separate GO decisions for Formality and PrimeTime from prohibited physical, power, speedup and paper-ready claims.

severity_definition.P0: Evidence invalidation, functional contradiction, falsified headline, corrupted seal or frozen-document mutation.
severity_definition.P1: Admission-blocking gap before the next requested stage or a material methodological defect.
severity_definition.P2: Non-blocking auditability, coverage or physical-realism debt retained under an explicit claim boundary.

pass_rule: PASS only if all M416 DC contract gates independently reproduce, both functional predecessor seals verify, the M401 cycle ledger and docs/359 identity are unchanged, and no prohibited claim is upgraded. Formality and PrimeTime remain subsequent gates rather than facts proved by M417.
red_lines: Do not modify RTL or docs/359.
Do not use an open-source RTL tool.
Do not call M416 physical timing, SRAM-inclusive area, energy, system speedup, paper PPA or a DATE headline.
Do not subtract DEL cells as physical savings or attribute them solely to the 25 ps hold guard without an A/B run.
Do not treat the M414 testbench raw cycle counter as a speed metric.
